_note: Speaker IDs only. No speaker is in more than one split. Severity from Rudzicz et al. 2012 (TORGO).

torgo._why: test: F04 = female, very mild; M01 = male, severe. dev: M05 = male, moderate to severe. train: F01 severe, F03 moderate, M02 severe, M03 very mild, M04 severe.

librispeech.dev_clean_halves: dev-clean speakers sorted by ID, alternating within each gender: even positions = train (typical-speech mix), odd positions = dev

personal._how: split by sentence (the same sentence is never in both), fixed seed
